en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Ubeyda, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘(Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup> remained after Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> for seventy five days, and intense grief entered into her<sup>asws</sup> upon her<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>saww</sup>, and Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> used to come to her<sup>asws</sup> and would excellently console her<sup>asws</sup> upon her<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>saww</sup>, and that would make her<sup>asws</sup> better and he<sup>as</sup> would inform her<sup>asws</sup> about her<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>saww</sup>, and his<sup>saww</sup> place, and he<sup>as</sup> would inform her<sup>asws</sup> with what would be happening after her<sup>asws</sup> among her<sup>asws</sup> children, and Ali<sup>asws</sup> would write that down’.
en.sarwar: Fatima (a.s.) was born five years after the Messenger of Allah declared his message. She died when she was eighteen years and seventy five days old. She lived for seventy five days after the death of her father (s.a).”
